answer: Each participant locks 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly assigned reviewers who share no funder and no earlier co-review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays public: a pulse of synchronized entries exposes scripted farms, a violet seal binds each submission to one issuer so reuse is visible, and a horizon of sustained tenure gates premium work. Every extra sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so cloning costs more than honest labour.
